record.paper_title: Hénon maps: a list of open problems
record.original_question: For each 0≤α≤log 2, is the real isentrope E_α={(c,b)∈R^2 : h_top(f_{c,b}|_{R^2})=α} connected?

evidence.quote: Question 28 (van Strien [138]). — Is the isentrope Eα connected for any 0 ≤ α ≤ log 2 ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For real parameters $(c,b)\in\mathbb{R}^2$ with $b\neq 0$, consider the Hénon map
$$f_{c,b}:\mathbb{R}^2\to\mathbb{R}^2,\qquad f_{c,b}(x,y)=(c-x^2-by,\ x).$$
Let $h_{\mathrm{top}}(f_{c,b}|_{\mathbb{R}^2})$ denote the topological entropy of $f_{c,b}$ acting on $\mathbb{R}^2$. It is known that $0\le h_{\mathrm{top}}(f_{c,b}|_{\mathbb{R}^2})\le \log 2$. For each $\alpha\in[0,\log 2]$, define the real isentrope
$$E_\alpha=\{(c,b)\in\mathbb{R}^2 : h_{\mathrm{top}}(f_{c,b}|_{\mathbb{R}^2})=\alpha\}.$$
Determine whether, for every $\alpha\in[0,\log 2]$, the set $E_\alpha$ is connected.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is listed as an open problem attributed to van Strien in a recent compilation of open problems on Hénon maps (2023/2024). The analogous statement is known for quadratic and cubic polynomials (Milnor–Tresser and related results), and the top isentrope $E_{\log 2}$ is known to be connected, but the general case for the Hénon family remains unresolved.

status_evidence.snippet: Question 28 (van Strien). — Is the isentrope Eα connected for any 0 ≤ α ≤ log 2?
status_evidence.claim: The connectedness of the real Hénon isentropes is listed as an open question.

status_evidence.title: On Parameter Loci of the Hénon Family
status_evidence.snippet: Study of isentropes and parameter loci in the Hénon family.
status_evidence.claim: Related parameter-locus results for the Hénon family but no complete answer to connectedness of all isentropes.
